title: Grill round 2 — PR surfaces, the summary under the button, and dialog dismissal

scope-surfaces.title: Which task-creation surfaces must use the combined Select Projects control?
scope-surfaces.display: New Task panel; Issue task dialog (“Work on this with Agetor”); PR conflict dialog (“Resolve with Agetor”)

pr-selection.title: On the PR side, what may the combined control change?
pr-selection.display: Show the PR's repo locked in the same control; no extra projects

summary-under-button.title: What does “keep listing the project and branch selected under that” mean on the form?
summary-under-button.display: The per-project rows are the listing; no extra summary line

dismiss-behavior.title: Outside click is ignored — what about Escape, and which dialogs does that cover?
dismiss-behavior.display: Select Projects only: outside click ignored; Escape and Cancel still close
